cases.title: CDFEEDBACK opens the Feedback window with Send report and Cancel; Cancel closes it, prints exactly CDFEEDBACK cancelled. and sends or saves nothing
cases.plan_item: UX-WORD-03 CDFEEDBACK, Part A (Cancel) only (daily card D29)
cases.expected: CDFEEDBACK opens 'Creative Engineering | Feedback' with a 'Send report' button and a 'Cancel' button; pressing Cancel closes the window and the command line says 'CDFEEDBACK cancelled.'; neither result line ('Report sent to the office feedback folder' or 'Saved on this PC only') is printed; no window is left open and the drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The window, its buttons and the cancel path only exist in a live AutoCAD session.
not_automated: Part B (Send report: the one honest result line, the file in the office folder or on this PC) needs the spare Windows login and Tim's yes: not driven.
The feedback folder under %APPDATA% is not listed by the robot (no verb lists that folder); 'nothing saved' rests on the source (Cancel returns before the save) and on no result line being printed.
Whether the window text is readable and the buttons uncut is a Codex look (Codex D8-03 saw it readable on 3.0.78).
